notes:
Summary: Sonic Briefing builds post-call summarization + QA/coaching for large contact centers (telecom + utilities verticals). They want a replacement for their current hybrid stack (in-house ASR + third-party summarizers).

Key priorities / quotes:
- 'We need consistent QA scoring across 12k daily interactions and the ability to highlight coaching moments automatically.' — Head of Support.
- Emphasis on handling PII: DOB/SSN masking and strict retention controls.
- Reliability: must sustain 3k concurrent active calls during peak campaigns with graceful degradation (fallback to cheaper model variants).

POC scope and success metrics (what they asked us to prove):
- Summaries per call: 95% acceptable on human QA rubric (top-2 deviations).
- End-to-end post-call summary generation <= 30s for 95th percentile for 8–10 minute calls (batch post-call).
- Agent assist latency < 300ms for short-turn tool-calling in pilot flows (select agents only).
- Throughput: burst to 3k concurrent calls without >5% error rate or queue blowup.

Security / deployment notes:
- Preference for VPC or on-prem private control plane; cannot send raw audio to public hosted endpoints for Tier1 clients.
- KMS + audit logs mandatory; retention policy per client (30–90 days) and per-tenant residency.
- Will require red-team of security docs; legal negotiating data processing addendum.

Technical constraints / asks to SE:
- Sample rate and preferred ASR model compatibility (they use 16k/8k var audio, WAV + gRPC streaming). Need our runtime to accept pre-computed timestamps for QA highlighting.
- Offset mapping for call segments and ability to stitch channel-separated transcripts into one canonical transcript.
- Request for model fallback policy: primary high-quality model for coached calls, cheaper quantized variants for bulk nightly batch summaries to control cost.

Open questions / blockers:
- EXACT SLA for 99.9 latency during holiday flash-sales (they push 3x avg volume for 2 hours). How do we guarantee capacity?
- Legal: retention and deletion confirmation (automated purge proof).
- Pricing: want committed reserved capacity estimate for Dedicated vs hybrid private + hosted for non-PII workloads.
